item.title: In Maine, a new approach to practicing medicine in the sky
item.description: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.

item.title: Homelessness in the U.S. saw its largest drop in more than a decade last year
item.description: Homelessness declined after years of record-high levels but it still remains at nearly 700,000. The Trump administration and homeless advocacy groups cite different reasons for the drop.

item.title: The surprising and often forgotten history of economic populism in Texas
item.description: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Austin-based political commentator David Griscom. He authored a book titled The Myth of Red Texas which tells the story of economic populism in Texas.

item.title: Oklahoma tribes say proposed legal changes put ancestral lands in Ohio at risk
item.description: The Trump administration has proposed changes to the National Historic Preservation Act that could endanger historic sites significant to tribal nations across the country. Oklahoma tribes say that puts ancestral lands in Ohio at risk.

item.title: Housing affordability after the midterm elections
item.description: Housing affordability was a big issue for voters who helped sweep Democrats into power this week. Tackling it will take time.

item.title: Democrats plan to widen their probes of fatal ICE shootings
item.description: The killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti during the ICE surge in Minneapolis last winter was a pivotal moment for the country. After Democrats' sweeping wins this week, their deaths at the hands of immigration agents will likely be the targets of renewed investigations.

item.title: An unexpected activist emerged to help block a $5 billion data center in Maryland
item.description: Thousands across the U.S. have gotten involved to oppose data centers. One is a Maryland woman who'd been evicted after a pay cut and became a leader of a community effort that blocked a vast project.
